title: Wasserstein Barycenter Convexity Detects Hilbertian Geometry
summary: We prove that convexity of the Boltzmann entropy at Wasserstein barycenters is strong enough to distinguish Hilbert spaces from general Banach spaces. Thus Wasserstein barycenters provide an intrinsic optimal-transport test for Hilbertian geometry. More precisely, we show that if a finite-dimensional normed vector space, equipped with Lebesgue measure, satisfies the Wasserstein Jensen's inequality for the entropy at barycenters of arbitrary finite families of probability measures, then its norm must be induced by an inner product.
